difficulty: High: parallel shared phases, per-worker page-table switching, large-page partition/reference defects and physical copy/free/update ordering. First gate is exact real ABI + original C/Rust owned-host callback comparison, then full78/wholeTU/partial/default/native separately.
exact_borrowing: Request/arrays/process/VM/page table are caller-owned through synchronous SMP join; no new owner refs. Returned raw PTE/physical allocations stay valid until copy/free/update. Temporary PT restored on every original out path.
exclusions: Does not fold or alter accepted VDSO/ptrace, or untested FP/processVM/restart/cloneCPU fragments. No canonical/shared writes or jobs.
policy_integration: Append this private fragment after root central merge. No shared imports/types/ABI or old extern removal required. scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
